core.name: Malmö Stadsbibliotek
core.why: The main city library: Slottet plus Henning Larsen's Ljusets kalender, by Kungsparken. Everyone knows it and uses it as a landmark.

core.name: Malmö museum (Slottsholmen / Malmöhus)
core.why: The city museum in Malmöhus castle, with the aquarium, natural history and city history. It is the museum most Malmö residents have been to.

core.name: Teknikens och sjöfartens hus
core.why: The technology and maritime museum opposite Malmöhus, the classic school-trip museum. The tram and bus stop is still called Tekniska museet.

core.name: Moderna Museet Malmö
core.why: The national modern art museum's Malmö branch in the old Elverket on Gasverksgatan, with an orange perforated extension. Well known and permanent.

core.name: Form/Design Center
core.why: Design and architecture centre in Hedmanska gården by Lilla Torg, open since 1974 and visited about 100,000 times a year.

core.name: Orkanenbiblioteket
core.why: Malmö University's main library in the Orkanen building by Universitetsholmen. Students and commuters know it, and it is already in the game as Orkanen.

drop.name: Soldattorpet
drop.why: duplicate: it is the Limhamns museum building

drop.name: Hyllie Park Bibliotekshuset
drop.why: small library run by a residents' association, not the public Hylliebiblioteket

drop.name: Alnarps Lantbruksmuseum
drop.why: in Lomma and little known in Malmö

drop.name: Möllegården kultur
drop.why: Åkarp (Burlöv), a cultural venue rather than a museum, and obscure

drop.name: Kvarndala
drop.why: unknown OSM node near Tygelsjö with no other signal

drop.name: Digitaliseum
drop.why: tiny gallery with limited opening hours

missing.name: Malmö Konsthall
missing.why: Klas Anshelm's 1975 hall on S:t Johannesgatan, about 200,000 visitors a year, one of the best-known art venues in the city. OSM tags it amenity=arts_centre, so it was filed under scen. It is already in the game.

missing.name: Malmö Konstmuseum
missing.why: The city art museum (wikidata Q2791306, 14 sitelinks). The OSM building is the yellow pavilion in Kungsparken, the former casino, where the museum already runs exhibitions and where the city plans its new art museum (architecture competition 2026–27). The collection is also shown in Malmöhus, which is covered by the Slottsholmen entry. https://malmo.se/Aktuellt/Artiklar-Malmo-stad/2025-08-21-Gront-ljus-fran-kommunstyrelsen---Malmo-tar-nasta-steg-mot-ett-nytt-konstmuseum-i-Kungsparken.html

missing.name: Ubåten U3
missing.why: The submarine on land outside Teknikens och sjöfartens hus, part of Malmö museum. It is visible from the street and well known, but it sits 100 m from that museum; tagged historic=ship and tourism=attraction, with a sv Wikipedia article (HMS U3).

missing.name: Kommendanthuset
missing.why: Building from 1786 at Malmöhus. It now holds a café, Stadsbyggnadsforum and offices rather than a museum; include it only as a building.

missing.name: Signal – Center för samtidskonst
missing.why: Established contemporary art space (arts_centre, not in the long list). Not core.

notes: 1) Malmö Museer was renamed Malmö museum in 2023, so the game's label 'Malmö Museer' should probably become 'Malmö museum'. Malmöhus slott (relation/282978) is the same place as the Slottsholmen museum node; keep only one of them in the quiz, probably the castle under the sights category. 2) Malmö Konstmuseum is now in two places, Malmöhus and the Kungsparken pavilion, and its future building is in Kungsparken. The OSM building way/51451685 is in Kungsparken, so the Kungsparken point is the durable choice. The owner should decide whether it is core: I ranked it core because of Wikidata sitelinks and the city's investment. Malmöhus lifts are being replaced until March 2027, so the third floor is closed. 3) Malmö Konsthall is tagged arts_centre and filed under scen; it should move here (core). 4) Skissernas museum and Kulturen are in Lund, north of the bbox (north edge 55.66), and are not in the OSM extract. 5) Ebbas hus is closed pending a renovation decision, so it is kept as everything with a caveat. 6) Disgusting Food Museum is in the game but is a private, tourist-oriented museum, so I put it in everything rather than core. 7) That leaves 8 core places (6 core + Konsthall + Konstmuseum), below the ~12 target: Malmö has few museums that residents commonly name. If more are needed, the next candidates are U3, Stadsarkivet, Rosengårds bibliotek and Garaget.
